description: Grants management of storage assets within Microsoft.Discovery storage containers: allows reading a storage container and creating, reading, updating, and deleting the storage assets within it, including checking the status of asynchronous storage asset operations. Cannot create, update, or delete the storage container itself, and does not grant access to the underlying Azure Storage blob data. Intended to be assigned alongside Discovery project roles. This role is in preview and subject to change.
